title: extract_response clones args JSON value on every call
description: client.rs:544: serde_json::from_value(args.clone()) deep-clones the entire JSON value tree on every response extraction. serde_json's &Value implements Deserializer<'de>, so T::deserialize(args) works directly for T: DeserializeOwned — no clone needed. For large method responses (e.g. Email/get with many messages), this clone is proportional to response size and happens per-call.
